subject: POC: Load testing & kickoff - scheduling and targets
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex@greengrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: POC: Load testing & kickoff - next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. GreenGrid is ready to kick off the POC and we'd like to schedule the hands-on load-testing and prompt review sessions next. High level asks:
- Review prompt sets and routing policies (we have a couple of fallback flows)
- Run benchmark/load tests to validate throughput and p95 latency SLOs

Initial throughput target: 200 req/sec sustained for 10 minutes (we can revise once we share logs). Target p95 latency: <150ms. We'll provide replay logs and workload profile as an attachment.

Proposed weeks: week of July 12 or July 19. Do you have availability for a kickoff + working session where your engineers can join?

Attaching: greengrid_workload_v1.csv (sample traffic profile).

Attendees from our side: Alex Green (technical lead), Jordan Blake (backend), Priya N. (product).

Thanks,
Alex
Technical Lead, GreenGrid Energy
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex@greengrid.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: Load testing & kickoff - next steps

Hi Alex —

Great, excited to get this started. Thanks for the workload sample. We can do a POC kickoff + hands-on session to walk through prompts/routing and then run the load tests.

Availability from our side: Tue July 13 (10am-12pm PDT) or Thu July 15 (10am-1pm PDT). Can you confirm which works best and which timezone your team prefers?

Quick checklist for the session:
- Prompt review (30-45m)
- Routing & fallback behavior (15-30m)
- Load testing run and monitoring (60m)
- Post-test analysis and next steps (15m)

Can you confirm the throughput and p95 target? You mentioned 200 req/sec and p95 <150ms — we want to lock that in before we schedule.

Attaching draft agenda: POC-agenda-draft.pdf.

Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Green <alex@greengrid.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: Load testing & kickoff - technical questions

Looping in a couple of technical questions ahead of scheduling:
- Will GreenGrid run synthetic traffic or replay customer logs? If replay, how large are the sessions and is there PII to scrub?
- Do you want to exercise KV cache/prefix caching and warm the cache before the test? That impacts effective throughput.
- Routing: do you plan to use a single model endpoint or multiple variants with fallback? If multi-variant, we'll need to model the routing percentages.

For load harnesses we typically run Locust or k6; we can also provide Redwood's internal test harness (see: https://redwood.ai/test-harness/locust) and a sample Locustfile to replay logs.

If you can share the replay sample (size and format) we'll prepare a test plan and a recommended ramp profile.

Thanks,
Dev
SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Green <alex@greengrid.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@greengrid.com>, Priya N. <priya@greengrid.com>
Date: 2026-07-03T10:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: Load testing & kickoff - scheduling and details

Marissa/Dev —

Thanks for the questions. We'll provide replay logs (sanitized) covering ~30k sessions — format will be newline JSON with request/response pairs. No customer PII in the sample we intend to share.

After checking with the team we've adjusted targets: target sustained throughput = 300 requests/sec for 10 minutes (burst to 500 req/sec for 1 minute), and target p95 <200ms (we can tighten later). We want to test both cold and warmed KV-cache profiles.

Preferred kickoff time: Thu July 15 at 10:00am PDT. Please reserve ~2.5 hours so we can do prompt review + routing + load test. Also want 30 minutes at the end for results.

If July 15 becomes a problem, July 16 morning is acceptable.

Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex@greengrid.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-05T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: Load testing & kickoff - scheduling and details

Hi Alex —

Heads up: we have a short calendar conflict on July 15 for a couple of our engineers. Would you be able to move to Fri July 16 at 9:00am PDT? That gives us a clear block and ensures Dev and Neha can attend for the full run.

We'll prepare two ramp profiles: 1) cold-cache ramp to 300 req/sec (10 minutes), 2) warmed-cache sustained 300 req/sec with a 1-minute 500 req/sec spike. We'll also include tracing and token-level cost breakdowns during the run.

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm. Attaching final agenda: final-poc-agenda.pdf.

Marissa
